tool_args.rationale: The paid slow-horizon observations establish a reversal near the target horizon. Fit all five parameters numerically in the specified sink-coupled dual-horizon law and request fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Plain dual-horizon adaptation without sink coupling
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It omits the observed gradient dependence and the recalled sink-coupled mechanism.
The gradient-dependent pilot and long-horizon reversal are better explained by sink-coupled adaptation.
The existing eight observations span short and long horizons and suffice to fit and freshly test the five-parameter candidate.
